# Aeon.VertiGate

Bonsai interface for the VertiGate Harp device.

The two `.Generated.cs` files come from `device.yml` in the repository root.
**Do not edit them by hand.** Change `device.yml` and generate them again. See
the repository README for the commands.

This file is for anyone who works on the interface. It is not the text that
NuGet shows. That text is in `README.nuget.md`.
